audit.whatIsWrong: Level-chart stages carried a closing verdict that contradicted the stage owner (for example a stage marked Ambessa ending "Camille is favoured here").
audit.why: The full-layer phase text was templated; the tail sentence was never reconciled with phases[].side, so the written verdict and the chart disagreed on the same page.
audit.corrected: Each phase why now closes with the verdict that matches its own side field, so early / mid / side-lane ownership reads consistently.

audit.why: Spike stages line up with the real kits: Camille at 2 (Hookshot, 16s at rank 1), 6 (The Hextech Ultimatum, 140s at rank 1) and her Sheen item; Ambessa at Public Execution (130/115/100).

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 stage told you to "use the cast's brief untargetable frame" on The Hextech Ultimatum to dodge Ambessa's key spell.
audit.why: Riot's own description of The Hextech Ultimatum is "Camille dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area" — there is no untargetable window. The kit file's untargetable/channel flags on R are tooltip-parse misfires and contradict the description.
audit.corrected: The stage now says the dash grants no immunity and keys R to being spent after the enemy spell rather than into it.

audit.why: Ambessa's real abilities are P Drakehound's Step, Q Cunning Sweep/Sundering Slam, W Repudiation, E Lacerate, R Public Execution.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds timing is stated even though Ambessa sustains through chip damage.
audit.why: Ambessa heals through Public Execution (R) per Riot's ability text, which decides every extended trade against Camille's short-trade pattern.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal timing should be named on the page; I did not have a length-legal slot to add it without cutting verified text, so it is raised here.

edits.before: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash stun and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Ambessa's Repeating Dashes is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before he answers. Camille is favoured here.
edits.after: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash stun and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Ambessa's Public Execution is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before she answers. Camille is favoured here.

edits.before: Full early kit with W online. Space the outer blade to heal, weave the empowered second Q for true damage, and keep E held until Repeating Dashes is committed. Camille is favoured here.
edits.after: Full early kit with W online. Space the outer blade to heal, weave the empowered second Q for true damage, and keep E held until Public Execution is committed. Camille is favoured here.

edits.before: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) isolates a target in a 1v1 they cannot leave. Use the cast's brief untargetable frame to dodge Ambessa's Repeating Dashes or burst, then focus the trapped target. This is a clean skill phase.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) isolates a target in a 1v1 they cannot leave. The dash grants no immunity, so spend R once Ambessa's Public Execution is gone, not into it, then focus the trapped target. This is a clean skill phase.

edits.before: Level 1 is genuinely yours: your Adaptive Defense passive shield eats her first auto and your Q already out-damages her opening poke, so you can step up where most divers can't. The lane really opens at 2-3 — bait out a dash, then E-in, W-pull on the outer edge, and Q-recast so the bonus true damage lands while she's still settling. Don't blow E early to chase: if she weaves her dashes around it your hookshot is gone for a long cooldown and she punishes you. Around Level 3 her dash combo starts flowing, so respect that window and trade on YOUR Q timer, not into her engage.

notes: Camille kit file flags R as channel/interruptible and untargetable; both contradict Riot's own description (a dash plus an anchoring zone) and were treated as tooltip-parse misfires, per the kit README. Packet win rate 58.65% over 578 games.
